No independent source found this pass names a distinct 'Barnaul-Shakhi' 50km leg as its own separately-built project. Every source fetched for this family (ap22.ru, neftegaz.ru 2019, tgs.tomsk.ru contractor page, politsib.ru) describes ONE continuous asset: a ~76-77km газопровод-отвод running from a tap point on the Novosibirsk-Barnaul trunk (P2283) -- named 'Шахов' (neftegaz.ru 2019) or 'Шахи' (per GEM's own P3368 segment name, likely the same place, case-variant spelling) -- to the Rebrikha ГРС. neftegaz.ru 2019 states explicitly: 'Строительство газопровода-отвода Шахов - Ребриха ОТ магистрального газопровода (МГП) Новосибирск - Барнаул на с. Ребриха началось несколько лет назад' (construction of the Shakhov-Rebrikha branch pipeline FROM the Novosibirsk-Barnaul trunk to Rebrikha began several years ago) -- i.e. the branch taps the P2283 TRUNK directly at/near Shakhov/Shakhi, not from Barnaul city via a separate 50km leg. This does NOT prove P3367 is fabricated or a pure duplicate -- Shakhi/Shakhov is presumably a real point along or near the P2283 corridor between Barnaul and Rebrikha, and a genuine 'Barnaul to Shakhi' stretch (whether as its own built pipe, or as a mis-modeled restatement of part of the P2283 trunk itself, or of the P3368 отвод's own routing) remains topologically plausible. But this pass could not independently corroborate it as a distinct, separately-constructed 50km asset with its own Start=2017 date, Owner, or spec -- every dated, on-point source describes only the single Shakhov/Shakhi-Rebrikha отвод (matching P3368 almost exactly: 76-77km vs P3368's 77km, both financed by Gazprom, both dated to the same 2016-2021 build history). RECOMMEND: a focused follow-up pass specifically on whether 'Shakhi'/'Shakhov' is (a) the tap point on P2283 where P3368's отвод begins -- in which case P3367 may be redundant with or a mis-segmentation of P3368/P2283 -- or (b) a genuinely separate, real intermediate settlement with its own distinct pipe segment GEM correctly captured separately. Not resolved definitively this pass; filed as a concern for review rather than a duplicate-removal recommendation, since no affirmative evidence of fabrication or duplication was found either -- only an absence of independent corroboration for it AS a distinct asset. contested left empty (no specific field/value correction proposed; this is a whole-row existence question).
